name: tmux-notify
description: macOS notification when Claude finishes a turn; clicking it brings your terminal forward and jumps to the session's tmux pane

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: Notification sound: a name from /System/Library/Sounds or ~/Library/Sounds (Glass, Hero, Ping, Submarine...), or none

terminalApp.title: Terminal app
terminalApp.description: Bundle id of the app to bring forward on click (com.mitchellh.ghostty, com.googlecode.iterm2, com.apple.Terminal, net.kovidgoyal.kitty, com.github.wez.wezterm)

previewLength.title: Preview length
previewLength.description: How many characters of Claude's final answer the notification shows
